data.narrative:
Radian Aerospace is a seed-stage space and aerospace company that has raised $27.5M to date. The valuation universe includes 5 public peers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private comparables in the Space & Aerospace sector, though achieving sufficient narrow-stage matching proved limited.

Of three triangulation methods tested, only stage-progression analysis was applicable. Using total capital raised ($28M) as a proxy for seed-stage valuation, a standard 2.5x multiplier to the next funding stage yields $69M. This method is straightforward but relies on the assumption that the company's trajectory matches typical seed progression in its sector. The peer-median approach was not viable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables meeting quality thresholds—while 14 same-sector peers exist, none of the narrow filters produced three or more datapoints. Public comparables in Space & Aerospace trade at a median 27.4x price-to-sales, but Radian's revenue was not available for application of this anchor.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $58M to $79M, centered on $69M. This narrow range reflects reliance on a single methodology and highlights the key uncertainty: lack of disclosed revenue data and limited peer density at the seed stage in this sector. Investors should weight this estimate conservatively given limited triangulation and the early-stage nature of the target.
